summary.text: Homar Gomez is a Democratic state representative from Easthampton who has represented the 2nd Hampshire District since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served on the Easthampton City Council and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Gomez was born in Puerto Rico, according to Ballotpedia, and his career experience includes working at Mitchell Funeral Home.
He previously served on the Easthampton City Council and took office in the Massachusetts House on January 1, 2025.
The Massachusetts Legislature lists his spouse as Sindy R. Mojica and says they have three children and two grandchildren.
Gomez serves on the Joint Committees on Agriculture and Fisheries, Municipalities and Regional Government, Public Safety and Homeland Security, and Revenue.
